question: What great accomplishment becomes dear to the yoginīs through this practice?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are conjoined as a goal
A great accomplishment is the subject
This accomplishment becomes dear to the yoginīs
inference: The practice yields a great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation cherished by the yoginīs
uncertainties: Whether priyo agrees syntactically with siddhiḥ or implies a masculine subject is slightly ambiguous
plain_english: A great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation may become dear to the yoginīs.
